identification: Box lot: cast iron flat iron (sad iron) with a decorative cast iron trivet; three plain stoneware jars (one large two-tone salt/brown glaze jar, two grey-buff preserve/ink-style jars with chipped, repaired or damaged rims, one small corked stone jar), sold as is; and a brown drip-glazed vase catalogued as McHugh (damaged). H. McHugh (Tasmania, 1930s) pottery is a collected Australian art pottery; Carter's reports 168 auction results $29-$8078, median $178. The vase here is a squat brown drip glaze vase with a rim chip/crack and loss (photos 2 and 5). Base mark not photographed, so a signed 'H McHugh Tasmania' base can't be confirmed from the photos.
marks_seen: Photo 1 shows all items, lot sticker 193; photo 2 close-up crack in rim of brown drip glaze vase; photo 3 and 4 show grey stoneware jar rims with filler/old repair; photo 5 shows chip on rim of brown glazed vase. No base marks visible.
google_searches: McHugh pottery Australia drip glaze vase vintage value (Carter's median $178; Etsy/dealer vases $85-400; MutualArt avg low; Tasmanian H McHugh 1930s with signed shape numbers)
